worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.summary: Stand still and squeeze a torrent onto the fist: a nearly instant straight punch whose reach is extended by the water lance. A hit soaks the target, drives it back along the jet and puts out a burning target's flames. The hammer form bursts on contact and shoves the target further.
worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.use.0: An instant heavy first punch at point-blank range
worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.use.1: Soak a target and shove it off its spot
worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.use.2: Finish a nearby foe or push a pursuer away
worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.description.0: The water-clad punch deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.description.1: It reaches %1$s blocks (the torrent extends the fist) and shoves the target about %2$s blocks along the punch.
worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.description.2: A hit soaks the target for %1$s, lowering its movement speed by 6%% while wet; if the target is carrying a burn, the punch cures it and puts out its flames.
worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.hammer.on: Hammer form: the torrent bursts on contact, shoving 1.7x further with a wider hit and pushing the target away; in exchange 0.9x power, 0.4 blocks less reach, a shorter soak and 6 ticks more cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.hammer.off: Lance form: longer, heavier and soaking longer, but it shoves less.
worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.growth.0: At level %1$s the torrent rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.growth.1: At level %1$s the torrent rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.preference.ha: On: the torrent bursts on contact, shoving 1.7x further with a wider hit, at the cost of 0.9x power, 0.4 blocks less reach, a shorter soak and 6 ticks more cooldown. Off (lance form): longer, heavier and soaking longer, but shoving less.
worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.preference.ai: It punches only at targets within this distance; the reach is short, so larger values often still mean walking in first.
On: targets already soaked rank lower, so it wets a dry one first; off: rank as an ordinary first-strike candidate.
On: below three tenths health the target is finished with this punch; off: it ranks as an ordinary first-strike candidate.
world_combat.move.jetpunch.text.douse: The water put the fire out
How long the wet of the punch's water stays on the target
worldcombat.skill.jetpunch.preference.ai: On: lowers priority against burned enemies to preserve ongoing damage. Pushback and finishing attacks remain available. Off: ranks by ordinary attack value.
